title: My 30 Day Chart Challenge 2026
text:
As every year, the goal for the #30DayChartChallenge 2026 edition is to create one plot per day for 30 days.
My plan is to:

Use the same dataset throughout all 30 days.
Save the R code in this repoand leverage R development tools.
Publish a Quarto website on GitHub Pages to showcase the plots.
